VIPLOVE GUPTA 
Functional Business Analyst – Liquidity / ALM / Banking Transformation 
Email: viplovepallavi@gmail.com  |  Phone: +91-9336139413  |  Location: India 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Functional Business Analyst and banking implementation professional with 13+ years of experience across BFSI, banking finance, risk 
management, Asset Liability Management (ALM), Liquidity Management, Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Profitability and Funds Transfer 
Pricing (PFT), regulatory reporting and loan management systems. Experienced across requirements gathering, functional analysis, 
design documentation, data understanding, configuration support, SIT, UAT, defect management, Go-Live and production support. 
Strong understanding of banking products, balance sheet management, funding and liquidity processes, financial analysis, reporting 
and profitability. Hands-on experience with Oracle Financial Services Analytical Applications (OFSAA) and ALM implementations for 
domestic and international banking clients. 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
• Functional Business Analysis and Requirements Elicitation 
• Liquidity Management and Asset Liability Management (ALM) 
• Balance Sheet Analysis and Interest Rate Risk Management 
• Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and Profitability Management (PFT) 
• Banking Finance, Risk Management and Regulatory Reporting 
• BRD / FRD / FSD / SMD Documentation and Traceability 
• Functional Gap Analysis, Process Mapping and Solution Support 
• Data Understanding, Source-to-Target Mapping and Interface Impact Analysis 
• PCC-to-LMS Migration / Integration, Data Migration & Validation 
• SIT, UAT, Test Strategy, Test Cases, Defect Triage and Regression Testing 
• Go-Live, Production Support, Change Requests and Operational Readiness 
• Stakeholder Management, Workshops and Business-Technology Coordination 
• Oracle OFSAA, Kastle ALM, PL/SQL Developer, QC/ALM, MS Office and Power BI 
DOMAIN EXPERTISE – LIQUIDITY / ALM 
• Asset Liability Management (ALM), liquidity management and banking risk management processes. 
• Balance sheet analysis, cash flow and financial statement analysis, funding structures and liquidity positions. 
• Interest Rate Risk Management, repricing analysis, maturity analysis and interest rate sensitivity reporting. 
• Liquidity risk management concepts, including liquidity measurement, monitoring, cash flow projections and maturity 
mismatches. 
• Exposure to Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR), Net Stable Funding Ratio (NSFR), liquidity risk reporting and related regulatory 
concepts. 
• ALCO reporting, structural liquidity statements, behavioural analysis, rate shock and option-adjusted gap analysis. 
• Functional requirements gathering, design documentation, configuration support, testing, defect resolution and implementation 
support. 
FUNCTIONAL BA & DELIVERY CAPABILITIES 
• Conducting stakeholder discussions and workshops to understand current processes, business needs and functional gaps. 
• Preparing and reviewing BRD, FRD, FSD and SMD documentation; translating business requirements into functional 
specifications. 
• Migration planning, lower-to-higher environment deployment, data validation and migration testing 
• Defining functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria for business validation where applicable. 
• Understanding source-system data, supporting source-to-target mapping, validating data elements and assessing 
upstream/downstream dependencies. 
• Preparing test strategies, test plans, scenarios and detailed test cases; coordinating SIT and UAT execution. 
• Analysing defects, participating in defect triage, coordinating resolution with technical teams, and performing retesting and 
regression testing. 
• Supporting business users, obtaining sign-off, coordinating Go-Live and providing post-production implementation support. 
• Acting as the bridge between Treasury/ALM, Finance, Risk, Operations, Business, Technology, QA and Project Management 
teams.
